sentence: This project builds a platform for the isolation, visualization, and long-term storage of extracellular vesicles.
This project studies how tiny signals in video conferencing can reveal private information and develops methods to prevent it.
This project uses mathematical models to study how ecological and evolutionary processes set limits on the energy that ecological communities can use.
This project assembles DNA strands holding silver clusters around gold nanoparticles and tests how well they catalyze chemical reactions.
This project studies how distributing authority among many users of a network can protect private data when some are compromised.
This project studies shapes defined by polynomial equations and builds parameter spaces that organize them in higher dimensions.
This project uses radars and unmanned aircraft systems to study how storm-generated boundaries relate to near-surface rotation in supercells.
This project develops a method that combines remote sensing data to map floods and assess damage to infrastructure.
This project builds cell culture methods for female and male human cells with defined sex hormones to study sex differences in disease.
This project uses mouse models to find out how a glutamate transporter helps neural stem cells divide and make new neurons in the hippocampus.
This project builds models that trace the origins of reactive pollutants in aquifers when the pollutants spread in complex ways.
This project expands a coral facility so scientists can study how thermal stress and ocean acidification affect coral and help restore reefs.
This project builds a computer vision tool that identifies bee species from images and a website where people share and check identifications.
This project develops a framework that makes deep learning models more robust against misleading features and adversarial attacks.
This project supports a workshop about natural language processing, which helps machines understand and generate human language.
This project tests whether carpenter ants and their microbial symbionts have evolved together in similar ways across North America.
This project builds a knowledge graph by extracting information from biomedical texts and a toolkit for making similar graphs.
